title: Title & Registration Services Expedited-Handling Charge on a Returned Packet
content:
When a returned Title & Registration Services packet goes back to the state, the tag lapse days are the calendar days from the tag lapse start to the day the packet goes back. An expedited-handling charge is added: twenty-five dollars (25.00) when the tag lapse days exceed fourteen, fifteen dollars (15.00) when they are one to fourteen, and nothing otherwise. Kestrel funds this charge itself and adds it to the same remittance that goes to the state with the packet.

| Tag lapse days | Expedited-handling charge |
|---|---|
| more than 14 | 25.00 |
| 1 to 14 | 15.00 |
| 0 (no lapse) | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, packet going back on 30 June)

| Tag lapse start | Tag lapse days | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 0 | nothing |
| 29 June | 1 | 15.00 |
| 16 June | 14 | 15.00 |
| 15 June | 15 | 25.00 |
